```{python}
#| label: onelead-live-setup
import pandas as pd
from live_results import *

SOURCES = {
    "terminal 1110000 screen": source_path("refine-logs/wavelet_ssl_1110000/full/queue.sqlite"),
    "15-epoch convergence queue": source_path("refine-logs/convergence_10e/queue.sqlite"),
    "repaired-mask 1111002 queue": source_path("refine-logs/wavelet_ssl_1111002/full/queue.sqlite"),
    "new spatial architecture queue": source_path("refine-logs/spatial_arch_1lead_v1/full/queue.sqlite"),
}
queues = {name: load_onelead_queue(path) for name, path in SOURCES.items()}
convergence_artifacts = load_summary_tree("refine-logs/convergence_10e/runs")
```

## Render-time status

```{python}
#| label: onelead-live-status
display(source_inventory(SOURCES))
rows = []
for stream, frame in queues.items():
    counts = frame.status.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict() if not frame.empty else {}
    rows.append({"stream": stream, "jobs": len(frame), **counts})
display(pd.DataFrame(rows).fillna(0))
display(convergence_artifacts.groupby(["run_state", "expected_epochs", "observed_lead"])
        .size().rename("artifact_runs").reset_index())
```

The source modification time and database state are authoritative for this
page. A lock file is not accepted as evidence that a process is alive. The
`1110000` screen is terminal and appears here only as a reconciliation check;
its 115 completed rows and five failures are analyzed in the completed-results
chapter.

The convergence queue ledger is stale. The run tree is authoritative for this
stream and contains 33 terminal artifacts: 23 at 10 epochs and 10 at 15 epochs.
Its old 12 `pending` labels are reconciliation defects, not live jobs.

## Running, pending, and failed jobs only

```{python}
#| label: onelead-live-nonterminal
for stream, frame in queues.items():
    if frame.empty:
        display(pd.DataFrame([{"stream": stream, "status": "source unavailable"}]))
        continue
    if stream == "15-epoch convergence queue":
        display(pd.DataFrame([{
            "stream": stream,
            "noncompleted_jobs": 0,
            "status": "stale ledger; 33 terminal run artifacts supersede pending labels"
        }]))
        continue
    active = frame.query("status != 'completed'").copy()
    columns = [c for c in ["ordinal", "id", "cell_name", "status", "attempts",
                              "started_at", "updated_at", "error", "log_path"] if c in active]
    display(pd.DataFrame([{"stream": stream, "noncompleted_jobs": len(active)}]))
    display(active[columns].sort_values([c for c in ["status", "ordinal"] if c in active]))
```

## Registered evidence tiers

| Stream | Scientific role | Result handling |
|---|---|---|
| `1110000` | three-epoch seed-42 screen | terminal; never call it live |
| convergence | promoted 10/15-epoch extensions | 33 artifact-backed completions; stale queue labels are not treated as active |
| `1111002` | repaired-mask/six-boundary replication | protocol only until jobs complete |
| `spatial_arch_1lead_v1` | expanded spatial architecture design | protocol only until jobs complete |

Preflights, archived failed generations, and partial summaries are engineering
evidence. They are not pooled with scientific results.
